references.text: Moses was eighty years old when he stood before Pharaoh, which confirms his age and service.
The Lord told Moses that he would not lead the people into the promised land because of his disobedience at Meribah.
The Lord told Moses that he should see the land but not enter it, and that he would die on the mountain.
Moses asked the Lord to let him cross the Jordan, but the Lord refused and said he could only see the land from a distance.
It confirms that Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died, and that his eyesight had not weakened.
After Moses' death, the Lord commanded Joshua to lead the people across the Jordan into the promised land.
Stephen mentions that Moses was forty years old when he visited his brothers, as part of his life story.
